subject: Hospitality
title: The Check-In Experience Redesigned
description: A short lesson to help you apply The Check-In Experience Redesigned.

hook.text: Standing in line at a front desk after a long flight is the worst first impression. Hotels are redesigning check-in completely.

buildup.text: Mobile check-in lets guests skip the desk. Digital keys on smartphones unlock doors. The lobby line may soon be extinct.

discovery.text: The Check-In Experience Redesigned reveals the mechanism or argument that changes the picture.

twist.text: Luxury hotels push back. Their guests WANT the personal greeting, the welcome drink.

climax.text: The future is segmented: tech-forward self-service for efficiency-seekers, curated personal check-in for experience-seekers.

punchline.text: Kiosks for speed, concierges for warmth. Check-in splits into two paths.

quiz.question: How did CitizenM redesign the check-in experience?
options: Self-service kiosks replacing the front desk—check-in takes 60 seconds
